- Points mode now shows an animated result on the match summary, with the final score and a clear indication of whether you reached your goal.
- Challenge voting now appears below the challenge cards in OBS. Viewers vote by typing **1**, **2**, **3**, or **4** in Twitch chat.

Download **CS2Tasks.exe** from **Assets**. To update, exit the app from the system tray and replace the executable in the same folder.
